verdict.rationale: Exa's own docs say Search returns ranked web results with clean page content. Highlights mode returns query-relevant excerpts sized to each result's relevance while controlling context size, with token-efficient extracts and a recommended 4,000-character size, which is built for feeding LLM context. A hands-on user integrating it into an agentic chatbot was impressed, but asked for a cruft cleaner to trim what reaches the downstream LLM. missing for 10: independent evidence on ranking quality for RAG use, documented fine-grained size controls beyond the 4,000-character recommendation, built-in cleanup of residual page cruft.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get results sized and ranked for direct use as LLM context in a RAG pipeline
